summary: Risk-on rally has extended into the afternoon (S&P 500 and Nasdaq up about 2.3-2.6% by 1 PM ET as oil falls ahead of Tuesday's CPI) while Nvidia stays down about 5.5% on the Huang board probe. Since the last update, DraftKings was dropped as a put fighting the tape and replaced by a GE Vernova call on the AI-power rebound; confidences trimmed for less time left. Quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news reports.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Up about 10% on the Oppenheimer upgrade and Google Cloud EPYC win with the chip rally widening; a clean break of $500 targets $510.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Up about 5% on JPMorgan's focus list (AWS growth above 40%) as the index rally extends; above $270 keeps $275-279 in play.

picks.name: Meta Platforms
picks.reason: Up about 5% after JPMorgan added it to its focus list; a break of the 644.54 intraday high extends it.

picks.name: GE Vernova
picks.reason: Up about 7% ($53.80) with AI-power names like Bloom and Coherent surging on the rebound; a push through $840 extends the trend day.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 5.5% on the board probe of CEO Huang and lagging the chip rally; losing the 170.24 opening low resumes the slide.

picks.name: Eli Lilly
picks.reason: Up about 2% after Jefferies set a street-high $1,700 target on ex-US GLP-1 demand; a break of $1,400 extends it.
